title: Store Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: A data store: a named database, bucket, table, index, queue or secret. A resource owned by one bounded context and recorded on the service that owns it and on the node that hosts it, not a service of its own (Backstage's resource; the continuum's decision D1). Usually a row of a stores register; a store may also have a page of its own.

technology.description: The technology the store is kept in, e.g. PostgreSQL 16, Cloud Storage, BigQuery.

part_of.description: The one bounded context that owns the store.

owned_by.description: The service that owns the store, by slug. The inverse of stores on the service.

hosted_on.description: The node that hosts the store. The inverse of hosts_stores on the node.

written_by.description: Services other than the owner that write to it; each is a finding against the one-owner rule unless it goes through the owner's contract.
